title: the newest RSS item must be within the freshness window

spec.name: RSS 2.0
spec.normative_quote: RSS 2.0 does not define a freshness window for the newest item. This seven-day limit is local policy.
spec.note: No external specification imposes the threshold.
spec.verification_note: Clause n/a. The quote states the absence of an external freshness rule and records this repo's local policy.

applicability: A parsed RSS channel with at least one parseable item pubDate.
expectation: The newest pubDate is not more than maxAgeDays before evaluation. Exactly seven days old passes.

cases.name: the newest item is more than seven days old
newest item is exactly 7 days old and the strict comparison passes
